cards.name: Aggron
cards.description: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.description: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.

cards.name: Snover
cards.description: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.description: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.description: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

cards.name: Surskit
cards.description: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.description: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every sets of paws tastes unique.

cards.name: Totodile
cards.description: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer need to be careful.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

cards.name: Lumineon
cards.description: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

cards.name: Meganium
cards.description: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

cards.name: Mesprit
cards.description: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.

cards.name: Typhlosion
cards.description: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.description: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

cards.name: Uxie
cards.description: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.description: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

cards.name: Alakazam
cards.description: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.description: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

cards.name: Bastiodon
cards.description: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.description: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.description: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.description: To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.description: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.description: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.description: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of Mantine swimming as if they are in flight.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.description: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.description: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Rampardos
cards.description: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.description: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

cards.name: Unown I
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.description: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.description: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Azelf
cards.description: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

cards.name: Whiscash
cards.description: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting of tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.

cards.name: Bayleef
cards.description: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

cards.name: Chingling
cards.description: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

cards.name: Cranidos
cards.description: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

cards.name: Croconaw
cards.description: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.description: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.description: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.description: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scale will heal even incurable illnesses.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.description: Its tail also has a small brain. It bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on it from behind.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.description: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.description: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.

cards.name: Happiny
cards.description: It loves round white things. It carries and egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.description: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.

cards.name: Masquerain
cards.description: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.description: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO's.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.description: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.description: A mushroom grown larger than the host's body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

cards.name: Quilava
cards.description: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burn more strongly when it readies to fight.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.description: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.description: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

cards.name: Shieldon
cards.description: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.

cards.name: Unown E
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown M
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Unown T
cards.description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.description: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

cards.name: Abra
cards.description: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.description: It has the power to travel across time, but is is said to appear only in peaceful times.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

cards.name: Aron
cards.description: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Barboach
cards.description: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

cards.name: Chikorita
cards.description: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.description: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.description: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.description: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

cards.name: Finneon
cards.description: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.description: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.

cards.name: Gible
cards.description: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.description: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

cards.name: Magby
cards.description: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees F. It is healthy if it is breathing yellow flames.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.description: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.

cards.name: Nidoran♀
cards.description: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

cards.name: Paras
cards.description: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.

cards.name: Pichu
cards.description: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.description: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.description: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

cards.name: Seel
cards.description: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.description: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
